title: Two Linked Sequences
statement:
Sequences of real numbers $x_1, x_2, x_3, \dots$ and $y_1, y_2, y_3, \dots$ satisfy $x_1 = 3$, $y_1 = 7$ and, for every positive integer $n$,
$$x_{n+1}^2 + y_{n+1}^2 + x_n^2 + y_n^2 = 2x_n y_{n+1} - 2x_{n+1} y_n.$$
Find the value of $$\sum_{n=1}^{2026} n \cdot x_n.$$
hints: Move every term of the relation to one side. Then look at how the terms pair up: $x_{n+1}^2$, $y_n^2$ and $2x_{n+1}y_n$ belong together, and so do $y_{n+1}^2$, $x_n^2$ and $-2x_n y_{n+1}$.

Use a sum of squares. The rearranged relation says that two perfect squares add up to $0$, and for real numbers this forces each square to be $0$. This gives simple formulas for $x_{n+1}$ and $y_{n+1}$ in terms of $x_n$ and $y_n$.

The relation becomes $(x_{n+1} + y_n)^2 + (y_{n+1} - x_n)^2 = 0$, so $x_{n+1} = -y_n$ and $y_{n+1} = x_n$. The $x_n$ therefore repeat as $3, -7, -3, 7, \dots$. Each block of four consecutive terms of the sum, starting from $n = 1$, equals $8$, and $2026 = 4 \cdot 506 + 2$, so two terms are left over.
solution:
The condition rearranges to $(x_{n+1}+y_n)^2+(y_{n+1}-x_n)^2=0$, so $x_{n+1}=-y_n$ and $y_{n+1}=x_n$.

Then $x_{n+2}=-y_{n+1}=-x_n$, so $x_n$ runs $3,-7,-3,7$ with period $4$.

Each block $n=4k+1,\dots,4k+4$ contributes
$$3(4k+1)-7(4k+2)-3(4k+3)+7(4k+4)=-6+14=8.$$
Since $2026=4\cdot506+2$, the $506$ blocks give $4048$. The remaining terms are $2025\cdot3-2026\cdot7=-8107$.

The sum is $4048-8107=-4059$.
